title: Symbolic KAN RTL Synthesis
theoretical_validation: The structural implementation maps VOCAB directly to case statements. ADD, CMP, and EQ map to LUTs. MUL maps to DSPs. Synchronous summation tree is inferred. This theoretically validates REQ-MODEL-030 and SCENARIO-MODEL-015 in an RTL context.
honest_verdict: success: RTL structural logic validated theoretically and mapped to Verilog/TCL specification for Symbolic-KAN.
